name: Staff — complaint detail shows the location, office distance and Directions link

planSteps.description: The page shows a DESCRIPTION section with the complaint text and a LOCATION section
The LOCATION section shows a latitude, longitude pair beginning "14." and "121."
A map is rendered in the location block (a MapLibre canvas with the MapTiler / OpenStreetMap attribution visible)
A line of text under the map mentions the CENRO office and a distance in km or m
A "Directions" link is present and its href points at google.com/maps with an origin and destination
A REPORTER section lists the reporter name and contact details
